resources.string: HTTPS Streamable HTTP is supported. Local HTTP requires the advanced option.

Only http://127.0.0.1:port is allowed. Other apps on this device can access the port, so the server must require Bearer authentication. Enter its access token below. Local tools require process execution approval.
The token is encrypted on this device and excluded from the MCP address and ordinary settings. To change it, delete and add the server again.
Enter a valid HTTPS address, or enable the advanced option and use http://127.0.0.1 with a valid explicit port.
Local MCP requires a valid Bearer token without spaces, line breaks, or a Bearer prefix.
Could not save the MCP configuration or credentials. Please try again.
Local HTTP MCP is disabled or missing an access token. Open the advanced option in Add MCP, or delete and add the server to configure its token.
